address: Paseo Marítimo Rey de España 161, Fuengirola, 29640, Spain
bio: Everyone is familiar with or has heard of Los Marinos José, an icon of maritime-inspired dining along the Playa de Carvajal on the Costa del Sol. Completely renovated in a modern, elegant style, it now features a kitchen open to the dining room, its always incredible display cabinets (its fish and seafood are striking for their exquisite quality) and a semi-glass-enclosed terrace. Everything is delicious here, but if we had to make a recommendation we would suggest the shrimp from Motril, the langoustine from Huelva, and the famous red prawns. Much of the catch is from the restaurant’s own boats!...
